title: Exploring the Efficacy of Automatically Generated Counterfactuals for Sentiment Analysis

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model robustness by comparing prediction accuracy on original in-domain data versus out-of-domain generalization datasets and counterfactually augmented challenge datasets to measure the model's reliance on non-causal artifact words (e.g., specific nouns or names like "film" or "Nolan") rather than genuine sentiment indicators.
